name: empty_message
notes: Zero fields, flush_to_byte_boundary produces one zero byte

name: two_u32_fields
schema:
namespace test.msg
message M { x @0 : u32  y @1 : u32 }

name: mixed_bool_u16_string
schema:
namespace test.msg
message M { flag @0 : bool  count @1 : u16  name @2 : string }
notes: bool(1 bit, flush to 0x01) + u16(LE 0x002A) + string(LEB128 len 4 + 'test')

name: nested_message_u16
notes: Nested messages are inlined: Child's u16 little-endian value is 07 00.
